name: Distressor
notes: Probed 2026-11-23. Input, attack, release and output are 0-10 knob positions and Detector / Audio are Distressor modes: none of them mean anything on other compressors, so they aren't carried. They come back as you left them when you return to the Distressor.
NUKE reads as a limiter (inf:1); a limiter setting from elsewhere goes to NUKE. Mix is read through a measured table.
